name: Mortem Metallum
desc:
New shop item: Ballista (new servers only)!

Beginner servers for Mortem Metallum. You will be automatically sent to the beginner game if you have under 30 kills and a friend isn't in the server.

Mortem Metallum is a melee and ranged combat game originally created by Ender1709.

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

Default controls:

E: Dash (grants temporary immunity)
Q: Kick (deals damaged to downed players)
F: Parry (depending on option, stuns enemy player or heals you)
Z: Carry (downed players only)
R: Interact (with crates and map objects)
Control: Camera Lock

These can be changed in the control section of settings.
